item.title: Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields Festival Has No Overlapping Sets: See the Full Schedule
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in music. Today, we're talking about Olivia Rodrigo and her exciting new festival, Daisy Chain Fields. Let's get started!"
[Music transitions to a soft, upbeat tune]
Host: "Daisy Chain Fields is an all-women festival, and the best part? No overlapping sets, so you can catch every performance without missing a beat. The festival is scheduled for August 29th at Great Park in Irvine, California, and the lineup is incredible, featuring Chappell Roan, Garbage, Doechii, The Breeders, Mitski, Bikini Kill, and many more."
[Music transitions to a short clip of Olivia Rodrigo's music]
Host: "Olivia Rodrigo is set to headline the festival, performing from 8:40pm to 10pm on the Dandelion Stage, with special guests Karen O, Sarah McLachlan, and Stevie Nicks. The festival is not only a celebration of music, but also a fundraiser, with 100% of the net proceeds going to charities that support women and girls, including organizations like Planned Parenthood, Baby2Baby, and the National Women's Law Center."
[Music transitions back to the soft, upbeat tune]
Host: "Tickets are available in four tiers, ranging from $255 for general admission to $1,255 for pit viewing. And if you're interested in attending, you can check out the waitlist on the festival's website. This festival is part of Olivia Rodrigo's ongoing efforts to make a positive impact, following her Fund 4 Good initiative and her recent Catalyst of Change award from Planned Parenthood."
[Music transitions to a clip of Olivia Rodrigo talking about the festival]
Host: "As Olivia Rodrigo said, 'The lineup is truly insane and full of my heroes and friends. I firmly believe that joy, community, and music can be the drivers of meaningful change, and I'm hopeful this festival will be just that.' We couldn't agree more, and we're excited to see the impact that Daisy Chain Fields will have."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. If you're interested in attending Daisy Chain Fields or learning more about Olivia Rodrigo's upcoming tour, be sure to check out our show notes for more information. Don't forget to follow us for more music news and updates, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
